control.approvalsText: Turning on the terminal, removing a hub and shutting down a device need confirmation from another hub. If too few hubs are online, the quorum drops.
control.quorumText: 1 = you decide alone. 2 or 3 = one or two other hubs confirm in Control › Approvals.
control.peersText: Pair with someone else's tailnet to share services and files. Code is never shared.
control.pairText: On the other hub, run python -m core --peer-invite --url URL_OF_THAT_HUB and paste the invitation here. Or copy yours and take it to the other hub.

help.title: Help · {name}
help.description: Commands for this hub, ready to paste.
help.head: Help
help.lede: Commands for this hub, ready to paste. Click one to copy it.
help.funnelText: Share a service with the globe button. It goes public through Tailscale Funnel on port 8443 or 10000, behind a link that expires and an optional password. Nothing else becomes public.
help.modulesText: Modules stay off until you turn them on in Control › Modules. To add one, put its folder in core/modules/ on the hub that signs your updates.
help.dailyText: Run these in a terminal on the device itself.
help.updatesAuthor: This hub signs updates for your mesh. Update Shoal here and every hub follows.
help.updatesFollower: This hub gets updates from the hub that signs them. To update Shoal, run git pull there. Here you can go back or pause.
help.tsText: This hub is published on your tailnet with tailscale serve at /hub.
help.tsTermux: Android has no tailscale serve: this hub answers at http://<this phone>:{port}/hub/ inside your tailnet.
help.addText: Run the one for its system on the new device, with Tailscale connected. It downloads Shoal from this hub and joins the mesh.
help.unavailable: Could not read this hub's details. Is it up to date?
help.roleAuthor: signs them for the mesh (your first hub)
help.roleFollower: receives them from the hub that signs
help.cmdRelease: Running version, previous version, paused or not
help.cmdPull: Get the latest Shoal and apply it now
help.cmdRollback: Go back to the previous version
help.cmdPause: Stop taking updates on this device
help.fixUnreachable: The page does not load: check "Is the hub answering?" above. If it answers on 127.0.0.1:{port} but not on its address, look at tailscale serve status.
help.fixOffline: Another hub shows as offline: run these commands on that device. A hub counts as offline after three minutes without news.
help.fixUpdate: An update went wrong: go back to the previous version in Control › Settings or with the command above. No hub installs that version again.
help.fixNotify: No notifications: allow them in Notifications on each browser. Sending them needs a hub with the Tailscale CLI and pywebpush (a PC or a server).
